item.title: Southern Arizona Temperatures Climb 15 Degrees Above Normal This Week
item.description: A significant warming trend is set to take hold across southeastern Arizona this week, with temperatures climbing well above seasonal averages by the second half of the workweek.

item.title: Fugitive wanted in Pima County on violent charges captured in Mexico after more than three years on the run
item.description: Fugitive Oscar Noe Alday, wanted in Pima County on violent charges, was captured in Mexico and returned to the U.S. after three years

item.title: Tucson's La Fiesta de los Vaqueros turns pink for breast cancer awareness
item.description: La Fiesta de los Vaqueros turned pink for breast cancer awareness Sunday, raising over $7,000 for a local non-profit that helps families affected. The rodeo runs through March 1.
